jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Mexico

Senior Integration Engineer

Remote, Mexico

JOB OVERVIEW

Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration & Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.

Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.

Technical Integrations

  • Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems.
  • Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato
  • Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.
  • Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.
  • Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.
  • Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.

Legion Product Expertise

  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.
  • Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.
  • Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues
  • Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.
  • Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.
  • Write well-designed, testable, efficient code
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle
  • Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.

Team Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.
  • Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.
  • Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.
  • Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.
  • Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800
  • This role involves participation in on-call rotation.
  • This role may require work outside of normal business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience
  • Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree
  • Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently.
  • Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach
  • Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening.
  • 3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices
  • Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC
  • Experience using Linux/Unix environments
  • Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java.
  • Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.)
  • 2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2
  • Demonstrate experience with test-driven development.
  • Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services
  • Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)
  • Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools.
  • Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

  • The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience
  • Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic 
  • Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence
  • Technical consulting experience.
  • Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.
  • Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. 

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. 

Benefits include, but are not limited to: 

  • Health Benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Parental Leave 
  • Equity 
  • Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY 

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.  Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. jobs.title: Hadley Designs LLC: Amazon Brand Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Flower Mound, TX, USA
URL: http://www.hadleydesigns.com

Own Your Catalog Like a Business, and Win on Amazon.

Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. This is a high-impact role for an e-commerce brand builder who brings real judgment, reads a market quickly, and knows how to grow net profit, not just sales.

You will report to the leader of our Amazon channel and work as part of a small, high-performing Amazon team. While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have built brands across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to bring that experience to a scaled Amazon catalog.

 

How You'll Win at Hadley Designs

You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.

  • Learn our brand. Get to know our brand, our expectations, your catalog group, and the standards and SOPs our team runs on.
  • Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.
  • Challenge the status quo. Bring better ideas, back them with a clear point of view, and help us raise the bar.

We are looking for thinkers who are coachable and confident, not people waiting for a playbook.

 

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end ownership of your catalog group's performance, including revenue, net profit, pricing, advertising, and inventory
  • Reading the competitive landscape, from merchandising and listings to imagery and pricing, and responding with strategy rather than reacting to every price drop
  • Finding inspiration outside Amazon, on Etsy, TikTok, Pinterest, and in wider trends, and turning it into product and format ideas
  • Product and format relaunches that lift your catalog
  • How your products look and compete on the page, from main images to packaging and format
  • Elevating our brand experience on Amazon so your catalog protects its margin and earns a higher price
  • Advertising, listings, experiments, and inventory planning with our supply chain team, used as levers toward profit
  • AI workflows that handle the routine work, so your time goes to the decisions that grow the catalog
  • Clear weekly reporting on results, risks, and next moves

 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Learn our brand, expectations, catalog group, and SOPs, and share a clear read of your competitive landscape
  • Own your catalog's weekly numbers and make the first judgment calls that protect margin and lift results
  • Bring forward product and format ideas, including ones inspired from outside Amazon, with at least one relaunch in motion
  • Challenge at least one way we do things with a better one, and be measured on the net profit you deliver

Requirements

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience owning a product line or catalog on Amazon, in e-commerce, or in marketplaces, end to end as a business
  • A strong visual eye, and you see what wins on the page, not only in the data
  • You read competitors and markets and can explain your reasoning, not just the answer
  • You find ideas outside Amazon and know how to turn a trend into a product or format
  • You know the tactics that grow net profit and you have protected margin and price
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon advertising
  • AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you are excited to build how we use all three now and going forward
  • Very organized and buttoned up, and you follow through until the job is done
  • Clear, confident spoken and written English
  • Coachable and quick to learn our way, and confident enough to challenge it

 

This is an ownership role for an experienced brand builder, not a virtual assistant position.

 

Benefits

Why You'll Thrive Here

  • Own a multi-million dollar Amazon catalog with a team that's got the tools and trust to help you scale
  • Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins
  • Remote full-time work with a flexible schedule
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO
  • Personal development and autonomy over your time
  • An established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
URL: http://www.praxismedicines.com

Location: India - Remote 

The Opportunity

At Praxis, every material movement matters. We are seeking a proactive, results-driven Manager, CMC Materials Management to own domestic and international logistics supporting our research, development, and manufacturing programs. 

This role ensures critical materials reach the right destination, on time and in the required condition, while maintaining compliance, inventory visibility, and cost efficiency across our global supplier and CDMO network. The ideal candidate anticipates challenges, solves problems with urgency, and takes ownership from planning through delivery. Success requires strong execution, attention to detail, and a commitment to advancing life-altering medicines for patients.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end materials logistics: Plan and execute domestic and international shipments supporting CMC development, technology transfers, and manufacturing. Coordinate suppliers, carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal teams to ensure timely, reliable delivery.
  • Ensure shipment integrity and compliance: Manage temperature-controlled shipments, packaging, monitoring, and material-specific handling requirements. Partner with Quality and Regulatory to ensure compliance with applicable procedures and promptly escalate excursions or deviations for assessment and disposition.
  • Drive accurate documentation and execution: Oversee shipping requests, including E-Transparency submissions, commercial invoices, packing lists, customs documentation, and Material Transfer Requests. Ensure complete, accurate, and timely records in the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Maintain inventory visibility: Track and reconcile material inventories at CDMOs and external partners, monitoring stock levels, expiry dates, and availability. Coordinate replenishment and transfers to prevent disruptions to development and manufacturing schedules.
  • Manage logistics partners: Partner with Quality and Procurement to select, onboard, and oversee service providers. Support negotiations, establish performance expectations, and hold partners accountable for delivery, quality, responsiveness, and cost.
  • Anticipate and resolve risks: Proactively identify transportation, customs, storage, and supply continuity risks. Develop contingency plans, resolve disruptions with urgency, and communicate clearly with stakeholders through resolution.
  • Improve operational performance: Maintain accurate shipment and inventory records in SharePoint, Excel, and other systems. Track delivery performance, temperature excursions, inventory accuracy, and freight costs. Use data and cross-functional collaboration to simplify processes, improve reliability, and reduce avoidable costs.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in logistics, materials management, or supply chain operations, preferably in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or a regulated environment.
  • Experience managing international shipments, customs documentation, freight forwarding, and temperature-controlled logistics.
  • Working knowledge of GxP requirements, quality systems, and pharmaceutical material handling and documentation.
  • Experience coordinating inventory and material movements across CDMOs, suppliers, or external manufacturing partners.
  • Proficiency with Excel, SharePoint, and logistics or inventory management systems; familiarity with E-Transparency, QMS, or ERP systems is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities across global teams and partners.
  • Ownership: Takes initiative, follows through, and drives issues to resolution without waiting for direction.
  • Collaboration: Builds trust through clear communication, transparency, and accountability across functions.
  • Curiosity and grit: Challenges inefficient processes, anticipates problems, and delivers results in a fast-moving environment. 

The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement.  You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

We provide annualized base salary compensation in the range listed below. Final salary range may be modified commensurate with job level, education, and experience.

Annualized Base Salary
₹2,580,000—₹2,860,000 INR

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans.  We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together! 

Company Overview 

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.  At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.  Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. Everybody Has A Role to Play in Transforming Healthcare

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Argentina
URL: https://stayd.co

Cleaning Operations Coordinator

Haven

Full-time | Remote — LATAM

Department: Housekeeping & Field Ops

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm ET | Occasional weekend coverage as needed

Reports to: COO, Cleaning

Compensation: USD $1,200–$1,500 / month depending on experience.

About the brand
Haven manages cabins and mountain homes in the Great Smoky Mountains and around Knoxville, Tennessee. Steep driveways, hot tubs, wood stoves, and a season that swings from quiet weeks to a full house every weekend. It is a market where property care is guest experience: a cold hot tub is a ruined anniversary, and a turnover that runs late is a family waiting in the driveway.

The role
You are the person who makes sure every cabin is guest-ready before the next family arrives. You are the main communication point between Haven operations and our Tendwell cleaning teams. Your day starts with the departures, arrivals and cleaning schedule, and from there you follow up with cleaners on progress and ETAs, clear whatever is blocking a turn, coordinate re-cleans and supply fixes, and confirm each home is ready before a same-day check-in.

When a guest checks out late, you work out what it does to the cleaning schedule and tell operations what timing is realistic. It is a role for someone who is highly responsive and calm under same-day pressure. Asking for an update is not the same as getting the home ready. If a turn is yours, you own it until it is confirmed complete.

Where you sit
You sit in Housekeeping & Field Ops and work every day with Tendwell cleaners and Haven’s operations team. This is not a role where you are handed a queue and left alone.

This role is remote and based in LATAM, covering U.S. Eastern Time working hours. Because Stayd runs shared systems across every brand, a process you improve here tends to end up running in six other markets, which is the closest thing we have to a promotion path.

What you’ll own

  • Follow up with cleaners on turn status, ETAs and anything blocking completion.
  • Coordinate re-cleans, missed items and supply fixes.
  • Confirm guest-ready status for every same-day arrival.
  • Assess how late checkouts affect the cleaning schedule and communicate realistic timelines.
  • Relay delays, updates and completion details to Haven operations, escalating urgent issues promptly.
  • Collect and post completion evidence, including photos where required.
  • Keep communication with cleaners, internal teams and stakeholders clear and organized.
  • Spot recurring issues and help improve cleaning workflows and SOPs.

What you bring

  • Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality, housekeeping coordination or field operations is strongly preferred.
  • High responsiveness and the ability to manage urgent, same-day issues without losing track of the rest.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Comfort following up with field teams, again and again, until the job is done.
  • Clear written English for communication with cleaners and the operations team.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours, plus occasional weekend coverage.
  • Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $1,200–$1,500/month, depending on experience.
  • Fully remote, with flexible scheduling within U.S. time-zone overlap.
  • A path to grow into a broader operations leadership role across the portfolio.

How to apply

About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Supply Chain Planner to support short-term planning for server hardware deployment. In this role, you will help translate customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans, track hardware availability, and ensure the right equipment is available at the right location and time.

You will work extensively with Excel, planning systems, and operational data to reconcile information, identify supply and demand gaps, monitor inventory, and track deployment requirements. This is a hands-on position that requires strong supply chain knowledge, analytical skills, and a willingness to manage detailed manual processes to keep planning activities accurate and on schedule.

You will collaborate with regional capacity managers and cross-functional partners, independently manage day-to-day planning responsibilities, and follow open actions through resolution. Trusted by global enterprises and high-growth mid-market organisations—including Vodafone, Merck, Arriva, and Hershey—the company reduces human cyber risk through AI-driven automation and cutting-edge Agentic AI solutions. We are scaling rapidly year-on-year, bringing our UK outbound engine in-house, and investing heavily in a modern, data-backed sales development function built for high performance and high autonomy.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As UK Outbound Sales Development Representative, you will sit at the very front of our growth engine. This is an autonomous, phone-first, results-driven seat responsible for establishing our in-house outbound presence in the UK market. You will target, engage, and qualify enterprise and mid-market security decision-makers—CISOs, Heads of Security, and IT Security Managers—booking high-value Qualified Held Meetings (QHMs) that directly build Keepnet’s sales pipeline.

Armed with an advanced outbound stack (including parallel diallers like Orum and Nooks, alongside HubSpot CRM), you will operate with freedom, high trust, and end-to-end account ownership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive Phone-First Multichannel Prospecting: Execute outbound campaigns across phone, email, and LinkedIn into UK B2B organisations, maintaining high daily call volumes via parallel dialling tools (Orum, Nooks) to maximise live decision-maker conversations.
  • Deliver Qualified Held Meetings (QHMs): Book meetings that actually take place with verified decision-makers (CISOs, IT Security Managers, and budget holders) in target accounts, operating against a target of your first QHM within 30 days and 10 QHMs per full production month post-ramp.
  • Execute Deep Discovery & Qualification: Apply the company's SDR Playbook (lightweight BANT and MEDDPICC frameworks) to uncover tooling gaps across phishing, vishing, smishing, and quishing, while assessing security awareness maturity.
  • Capitalise on Contract Renewal Windows: Identify current vendor relationships, contract lengths, and renewal dates, leveraging company's buy-back program to convert "in-contract" objections into active sales opportunities.
  • Maintain Channel & Conflict Awareness: Pre-screen accounts for existing partner relationships (MSPs, MSSPs, brokers, and resellers) and existing clients, resolving routing questions collaboratively before initiating outreach.
  • Ensure Seamless Handoffs: Document comprehensive, actionable discovery notes and transition booked meetings to Account Executives within 24 hours of scheduling.
  • Uphold Strict CRM Hygiene: Maintain HubSpot as the single source of truth—logging all interactions, preventing duplicate entries, and populating all mandatory qualification fields.
  • Operate with Built-In Compliance: Adhere strictly to UK GDPR, PECR, TPS/CTPS screening protocols, suppression list governance, opt-out handling, and approved messaging standards.
  • Feed Frontline Intelligence: Share objection patterns, competitor movement, and market feedback with Sales and Marketing to continuously sharpen outreach messaging and value propositions.
  • 2 Years+ of B2B SaaS Outbound Experience: Proven track record in a dedicated SDR or BDR seat carrying quota, generating pipeline, and booking qualified discovery meetings.
  • Phone-First Craftsmanship: Exceptional cold-calling confidence and conversational fluency; skilled at hooking senior prospects in the opening seconds, navigating initial brush-offs, and steering live phone discovery.
  • Enterprise Prospecting Capability: Credibility and commercial acumen to hold substantive, peer-level conversations with senior IT, Security, and Compliance stakeholders in organisations with 1,000+ seats without needing to be an engineer.
  • Parallel Dialler & Tooling Literacy: Practical experience using parallel diallers (such as Orum, Nooks, or equivalent high-velocity calling software) alongside modern sales engagement tools.
  • CRM Discipline: Rigorous data and pipeline tracking habits, with willingness to complete HubSpot certifications if not already held.
  • Flawless Communication: Outstanding verbal and written English skills, capable of composing compelling, error-free executive messaging without supervision.
  • Self-Directed Remote Discipline: Strong operational independence to manage daily activity, pipeline numbers, and metrics aligned strictly with UK business hours from South Africa.
  • Independent Contractor Readiness: Legally set up to operate as an independent contractor or registered entity in South Africa, maintaining a professional home office, high-spec workstation, noise-cancelling headset, and stable fibre internet.

PREFERRED:

  • Direct experience prospecting into the UK B2B market from an offshore/remote setup.
  • Prior background selling or setting appointments within Cybersecurity or related high-compliance technical SaaS sectors.
  • Experience operating as an early or founding SDR, building outbound cadences, lists, and messaging frameworks from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with indirect channel sales models, including MSPs, MSSPs, brokers, and value-added resellers.
  • Active hands-on proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and HubSpot CRM.

  • A Builder’s Mindset: You take full commercial ownership of your territory. If a workflow or list is suboptimal, you diagnose it, propose a solution, test it, and build a repeatable process.
  • High Question-to-Talk Ratio: The discipline that defines elite SDRs: asking sharp, incisive questions, actively listening, and documenting what prospects say—including negative signals—rather than pitching over objections.

  • Responsible Innovation: Familiarity with leveraging modern AI tools (such as Claude) within approved security and compliance guardrails to accelerate prospect research, personalise outreach, and streamline account tiering.
  • Resilience and Accountability: A relentless work ethic that thrives on pipeline creation, celebrates closed business, and takes pride in being the definitive first voice of the company in the UK market.

Base Pay: $24.00–$28.85 per hour (approximately $50,000–$60,000 annually), plus uncapped FTA bonuses and commission opportunities
On-Target Earnings (OTE): Approximately $75,000+ annually, based on performance
Reports To: VP of Sales

100 Dials a Day. Real Coaching. Get Paid When Your Appointments Convert.

We're looking for an experienced outbound sales professional who enjoys prospecting, tracks their numbers, and wants to be rewarded for results.

At Itechra, you'll make the calls, build relationships, and book qualified meetings. We'll train you on IT, support you through a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding plan, and provide ongoing coaching to help you succeed.

You'll earn a bonus for every qualified First Time Appointment (FTA) that converts to a Second Time Appointment (STA), plus commission on qualifying deals that close and generate client payment.

You don't need an IT background. You do need outbound sales experience, resilience, confidence on the phone, and the motivation to consistently achieve your goals.

This is a fully remote, phone-based sales position focused on generating business opportunities for our sales team.

What You'll Do

As an Outbound Sales Representative, internally classified as an Inside Sales Representative (ISR), you'll open doors for our sales team by connecting with business owners and IT decision-makers at companies with 25 or more computers.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Prospect every day. Make high-volume outbound calls, send emails, and use LinkedIn to reach business owners and decision-makers.

  • Do your homework. Research target companies, identify decision-makers, and gather relevant business information before reaching out.

  • Qualify opportunities. Ask thoughtful questions to understand each prospect's IT needs, company size, and purchasing authority.

  • Book qualified appointments. Schedule First Time Appointments (FTAs) that create opportunities for Second Time Appointments (STAs) with our sales team.

  • Manage your pipeline. Consistently follow up with prospects, nurture relationships, and keep opportunities moving forward.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records. Document calls, prospect details, activities, and follow-up information in HubSpot.

  • Track and report results. Provide weekly updates on activity, pipeline development, and conversion metrics.

  • Continuously improve. Participate in role-playing, call reviews, sales training, and one-on-one coaching.

How We Measure Success

We're a metrics-driven sales organization. You'll have clear expectations, ongoing feedback, and visibility into your performance.

Our established performance goals include:

  • Outbound Calls: 500+ per week (approximately 100 per day)

  • Decision-Maker Conversation Rate: 5% of outbound dials

  • Qualified First Time Appointments (FTAs): 12+ per month

  • CRM Accuracy: Complete and accurate documentation of calls, activities, notes, and next steps in HubSpot

If you enjoy measurable goals, friendly competition, and the opportunity to see your hard work translate into results, you'll fit right in.

Your First 90 Days: Training, Coaching & Performance

We believe strong salespeople deserve clear expectations, quality training, and consistent coaching.

Our structured 30/60/90-day onboarding program is designed to help you learn our business, build confidence, develop your skills, and understand exactly what success looks like.

Days 1–30 | Learn

  • Complete onboarding and training on Itechra's services, ideal clients, sales processes, and technology solutions.

  • Learn our prospecting tools, talk tracks, objection-handling strategies, and HubSpot CRM.

  • Participate in daily role-playing and coaching before and during your first live calls.

Days 31–45 | Ramp

  • Build toward and achieve 500+ outbound dials per week.

  • Participate in weekly call reviews and coaching sessions.

  • Demonstrate consistent prospecting, follow-up, and CRM documentation.

Days 46–90 | Perform

  • Maintain established outbound activity expectations.

  • Demonstrate consistent prospecting, qualification, and pipeline management.

  • Work toward the monthly goal of 12 qualified FTAs.

  • Meet individual ramp-up milestones outlined in your onboarding plan.

You'll always know where you stand. If you're coachable, accountable, and committed to improving, we'll invest in helping you succeed.

What You'll Earn

Your effort and results should create opportunity.

Itechra offers competitive hourly base compensation along with performance-based bonuses and commission opportunities.

  • Base Pay: $24.00–$28.85 per hour, equivalent to approximately $50,000–$60,000 annually based on a 40-hour workweek, depending on experience and qualifications.

  • FTA-to-STA Bonus: $250 for every qualified FTA that converts to an STA, with no stated cap. The bonus is earned when the qualifying STA is scheduled with a confirmed date and time, subject to the sales compensation plan.

  • Closed-Won Commission: 10% of the first month's recurring revenue for qualifying deals originating from your FTA. Commission eligibility is based on the applicable client invoicing and payment requirements outlined in Itechra's sales compensation plan.

  • On-Target Earnings: Approximately $75,000+ annually, including base pay and performance incentives. Actual earnings vary based on individual performance.

What Qualifies as an FTA?

A qualified First Time Appointment is a meeting you schedule with an IT purchasing decision-maker at a company with 25 or more computers.

Here's an Example of Your Earning Potential

If eight of your FTAs convert to STAs in one month, you would earn $2,000 in FTA-to-STA bonuses. Maintaining that performance for 12 months would generate $24,000 in annual bonuses.

If one qualifying appointment also results in a new client generating $4,000 in monthly recurring revenue, the associated 10% first-month commission would be an additional $400.

Bonuses and commissions are paid according to Itechra's applicable sales compensation plan.

Examples are for illustration only and do not represent guaranteed earnings. Actual compensation depends on individual performance, qualifying transactions, and plan requirements.

Where This Role Can Take You

We believe in recognizing performance, developing talent, and promoting from within.

Successful ISRs may have opportunities to pursue two career paths:

Inside Sales Team Lead

Lead, coach, and develop a team of Inside Sales Representatives. This potential advancement opportunity may be available to qualified remote employees throughout the United States.

Outside Sales Representative

Advance into a client-facing sales position focused on conducting Second Time Appointments, managing opportunities, and closing new business.

This career path requires residing in or relocating to one of Itechra's local markets, currently in Minnesota or Wisconsin.

Advancement opportunities depend on business needs, performance, qualifications, and position availability.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in outbound B2B sales, inside sales, business development, lead generation, or a closely related role.

  • Demonstrated experience with cold calling, prospecting, appointment setting, and CRM management.

  • Confidence engaging business owners, executives, and decision-makers and asking for the appointment.

  • Resilience and persistence when handling rejection and objections.

  • A competitive, self-motivated mindset with a focus on achieving measurable sales goals.

  • Willingness to receive coaching, apply feedback, and continuously improve.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate CRM documentation.

  • Ability to work independently, remain accountable, and maintain productivity in a remote environment.

  • A quiet, professional home workspace with reliable internet access.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An associate degree or higher in sales, business, marketing, or a related field.

  • Experience selling or prospecting within managed IT services, technology, or another consultative B2B industry.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar sales tools.

  • Experience prospecting to business owners or C-level executives.

This Role May Not Be the Best Fit If You:

  • Prefer working exclusively with inbound leads.

  • Are uncomfortable with daily activity targets and measurable performance expectations.

  • Prefer a highly scripted sales environment with constant supervision.

  • Are not interested in ongoing coaching, feedback, and professional development.

Benefits & Perks

At Itechra, we believe taking care of our employees is just as important as taking care of our clients.

Our benefits package for eligible full-time employees includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) options, subject to plan eligibility

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions, subject to plan requirements

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Employee assistance and wellness resources

  • Ongoing sales training and professional development

  • Employee recognition and performance incentives

  • Remote work opportunities within the United States

Benefits eligibility and effective dates vary by benefit and are governed by applicable plan documents and company policies.

About Itechra

Since 2001, Itechra has been a strategic technology partner to growing businesses.

We don't just keep the lights on. We help business leaders put IT, cybersecurity, AI, and automation to work at the core of how they operate, compete, and grow.

Our clients see us as an extension of their team, and our success is built on long-term relationships, accountability, and doing what's right for the businesses we serve.

We're continuing to grow and are looking for motivated professionals who want to contribute to that growth while developing their own careers.

Our Hiring Process

We believe in a structured, consistent hiring process that gives candidates the opportunity to demonstrate their qualifications and abilities.

  1. Apply Online: Submit your application and resume through Itechra's recruiting portal.

  2. Application Review: Our sales leadership team reviews qualifications and relevant experience.

  3. Pre-Employment Assessment: Selected candidates complete a 15-minute Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test (CCAT) designed to evaluate problem-solving and learning ability. Assessment invitations are sent directly through Criteria Corp.

  4. Interviews: Candidates selected to advance participate in interviews with our sales leadership team.

Assessment results are considered alongside relevant experience, qualifications, and interviews. No single assessment determines a hiring decision.

Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and hiring process. Applicants who require an accommodation may contact our People & Experience team at hr@itechra.com.

Ready to Prove What You Can Do?

If you're an experienced outbound sales professional who loves connecting with people, creating opportunities, and achieving measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help drive Itechra's next chapter of growth!

This position is open to qualified candidates residing and working within the United States, subject to Itechra's ability to meet applicable state and local employment requirements.

Itechra, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:

ABOUT THRIVE MARKET 

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.

THE ROLE

A contractor (30-40 hrs per week) who helps keep the paid social performance creative engine running: first-round ad review, QA and delivery, performance data, builds and decks, and ad hoc support for our creative strategist.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. First-round creative review

  • Review ads against the brief: does the concept, message, and offer answer what was asked?
  • Assess engagement potential (hook, first 3 seconds, clarity of CTA, platform-native feel)
  • Give team concise first-round feedback and flag what needs a closer look before it goes further

2. Creative QA & delivery

  • Check aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, etc.) and file specs (format, size, video length, safe zones, captions)
  • Check ad naming against convention
  • Confirm all assets are in (nothing missing) and the correct, approved version is used
  • Deliver to channel managers with a standard handoff note (batch contents, launch date, links)

3. Coordination & Workload Balance

  •  Keep track of what is due, what is ready, and what is at risk in Wrike and build out a 8-12 week rolling calendar
  •  Balance competing projects and flag blockers or slipping deadlines early
  •  Proactively contact the right people when a new project starts (designers, editors, copywriters, channel managers, brand/legal)
  •  Move work along on Sabrina's behalf (follow-ups, nudges), with signoff as described below

4. Ad hoc support

  •  Slot in last-minute asks and triage them by urgency, telling Sabrina what gets bumped
  •  Own small edit and resize requests end to end without Sabrina stepping in: no editing skills required, but coordinate with the project manager to find bandwidth on the editing team, brief the editor, and track the request through delivery

5. Performance data & reporting

  •  Pull performance data (Motion, Meta Ads Manager) and build recurring reports (top and bottom performers, spend by concept)
  •  Tag and categorize creatives (hook, format, angle, offer)
  •  Keep a testing learnings log
  •  Surface early takeaways to inform briefs and next rounds

6. Decks & strategy support

  •  Help build decks: test readouts, performance recaps, creative reviews
  •  Research competitor and inspiration ads
  •  Draft first-pass briefs or test summaries for Sabrina to review

QUALIFICATIONS

Core competencies

  • Proactive mindset; balances strategic objectives with day-to-day tactical execution  
  • Maintains timelines and prioritizes tasks for smooth workflows and timely delivery of creative assets  
  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats and shifting between review, data, and coordination work

Must-have

  • Background in performance creative (paid social preferred), with a trained eye for what makes ads engaging and on-brief
  • Strong attention to detail (specs, naming, completeness)
  • Clear written communication, able to give concise, constructive feedback
  • Organized and self-directed; comfortable with fast-changing priorities
  • Basic data pulling and deck-building skills

BELONG TO A BETTER COMPANY

We're a community of more than 1 Million + members who are united by a singular belief: It should be easy to find better products, support better brands, make better choices, and build a better world in the process.

At Thrive Market, we believe in building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic culture. If you are excited about this role along with our mission and values, we encourage you to apply.

Thrive Market is an EEO/Veterans/Disabled/LGBTQ employer

At Thrive Market, our goal is to be a diverse and inclusive workplace that is representative, at all job levels, of the members we serve and the communities we operate in. We’re proud to be an inclusive company and an Equal Opportunity Employer and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. We believe that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. If you’re thinking about joining our team, we expect that you would agree!

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please email us at eeo@thrivemarket.com and we’ll be happy to assist you.

jobs.title: Vertican: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New Jersey, USA
URL: https://vertican.com

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required

  • 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.
  • Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.
  • Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.
  • Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.
  • You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.
  • Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have

  • Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.
  • Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.
  • Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.
  • Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.
  • Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

  • A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software
  • Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.
  • Monthly payments in USD

Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Sacramento, California, United States
URL: https://www.vituity.com/about-us/practice-management

Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Instructional Designer

 

Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare

 

At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.

 

Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.

 

Vituity Locations: Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

 

The Opportunity

  • Designs and develops engaging, accessible, learner-centered learning solutions that support enterprise education, organizational initiatives, knowledge transfer, and performance.
  • Conducts learning and performance analyses to identify audience needs, desired performance, root causes, skill gaps, and appropriate learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Develops and customizes learning across modalities, including eLearning, instructor-led and virtual learning, blended programs, job aid, microlearning, simulations, assessments, video, communications, and other performance-support resources.
  • Translates complex content into clear, accurate, engaging, and learner-centered experiences through research and collaboration with SMEs and stakeholders.
  • Develops measurable learning objectives, instructional strategies, storyboards, scripts, prototypes, practice activities, assessments, and evaluation approaches aligned to intended performance outcomes.
  • Applies instructional design and adult-learning principles, learning science, usability, accessibility, content governance, brand/design standards; uses approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, design, development, and quality assurance.
  • Conducts quality assurance and user testing to identify and resolve content, accessibility, usability, and functionality issues before implementation.
  • Creates and edits multimedia assets and refreshes, improves, or retires learning assets based on feedback, data, content changes, and business needs.
  • Shares design approaches, tools, lessons learned, and work in progress to support team learning and consistency.
  • Participates in peer reviews and provides timely, constructive, and actionable feedback; seeks and incorporates feedback on their own work.
  • Applies established instructional design standards and contributes recommendations to improve templates, guidance, workflows, and best practices.
  • Independently manages assigned learning projects, including scope, timelines, milestones, stakeholder reviews, approvals, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • Balances multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and alignment with agreed-upon requirements.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve learning experiences, development processes, tools, templates, and team workflows.
  • Evaluates and uses approved learning technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency, and learner experience.
  • Contributes instructional design and digital-content expertise to pilots, cross-functional projects, technology testing, and improvement initiatives within assigned scope.
  • Partners with SMEs and stakeholders to clarify performance needs, desired outcomes, audience requirements, and project expectations.
  • Recommends appropriate learning, performance support, or non-training solutions based on identified needs and constraints.
  • Provides guidance on learning strategy, modality selection, learner experience, accessibility, and implementation considerations.
  • Communicates recommendations, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  • Builds productive relationships with internal partners and represents Learning & Development professionally.
  • May manage solely, or in partnership with the LMS Administrator, including but not limited to: uploading, testing, updating, maintaining, and retiring courses and curricula in accordance with established standards and processes.
  • Troubleshoots course-level Learning Management System (LMS) issues related to functionality, navigation, tracking, completion, and learner experience; supports testing of Learning Management System (LMS) updates and features and escalate system-level issues to the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator as appropriate.
  • Partners with the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator and stakeholders to support learner assignments and course delivery and develops or maintains SOPs and documentation related to instructional design processes and Learning Management System (LMS) interactions as needed.

 

Required Experience and Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, business, communications, or a related field required OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in instructional design or learning content development, with related experience in areas such as technical writing/editing, digital content, multimedia development, or content governance required.
  • Experience applying one or more of the following: adult-learning theory, learning science, instructional design principles, and fit-for-purpose methodologies—such as ADDIE, SAM, and backward design—throughout the learning-development lifecycle required.
  • Experience conducting learning and performance needs analyses; defining measurable learning objectives; recommending appropriate learning or performance-support solutions; and evaluating learning effectiveness required.
  • Experience designing and developing engaging, accessible learning experiences across multiple modalities, including e-learning, instructor-led or virtual instructor-led training, job aids, performance-support resources, and interactive multimedia required.
  • Experience partnering with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to gather requirements, translate complex information into clear and actionable learning content, incorporate feedback, and move projects through review and approval required.
  • Experience managing learning projects from planning through implementation, including scope, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder communication, and competing priorities required.
  • Experience working with a Learning Management System (LMS), including uploading and managing content, supporting course assignments, tracking learner completion, and assisting with course administration required.
  • Proficient in Articulate 360, including Storyline and Rise, with the ability to develop, update, test, and troubleshoot interactive digital learning content required.
  • Working knowledge of – and ability to apply – accessible and inclusive learning-design principles and applicable standards, including captions, alternative text, color contrast, keyboard accessibility, and accessible documents required.
  • Experience applying WCAG and accessibility standards to e-learning and digital learning content preferred.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable digital-media editing tools preferred.
  • Experience using learning analytics, learner feedback, assessment data, or performance data to improve learning solutions
  • Experience with learning platform reporting, course lifecycle management, or LMS quality assurance preferred.
  • Portfolio demonstrates learner-centered, accessible learning solutions across more than one modality preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design methodologies, learner-experience design, learning science, and performance-based learning.
  • Ability to analyze business, performance, and learning needs; identify root causes; determine when training is appropriate; and recommend practical learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Ability to translate complex, technical, or specialized information into clear, concise, engaging, and learner-centered content for varied audiences.
  • Ability to develop measurable learning objectives and align instructional strategies, content, practice, assessments, and evaluation methods with desired learning and performance outcomes.
  • Ability to design accessible and inclusive learning experiences by applying applicable accessibility standards and best practices across learning content and digital media.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, including managing multiple projects and priorities, establishing timelines, coordinating reviews, identifying risks and dependencies, communicating status, and meeting established deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration, consultation, and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members; facilitate productive discussions; incorporate feedback; and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Proficiency with LMS, multimedia, collaboration, documentation, project-management, and productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 applications such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to use learner feedback, assessment results, stakeholder input, and available learning and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve learning solutions.
  • Demonstrates the judgement, validation, confidentiality, and human-review practices required for responsible use.
  • Ability to work independently with initiative and sound judgment while contributing to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing, peer review, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement.

 

The Community

Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.

  • Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
  • Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
  • Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
  • Flexible work hours
  • Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

 

Benefits & Beyond*

Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.

  • Superior health plan options
  • Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D coverage, and more
  • Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6%25 plus discretionary profit-sharing contributions (eligible January following 18 months of service)
  • Generous paid time off starting 3-4 weeks’ annually
  • Student Loan Refinancing Discounts
  • Professional and Career Development Program
  • EAP and travel assistance included
  • Wellness program
  • Purpose-driven culture focused on improving the lives of our patients, communities, and employees

 

 

We are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $64,970 - $81,215, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual corporate Success Sharing bonus program, which is based on the company’s annual performance. If you are hired at Vituity, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please speak with a recruiter for more details.

 

We are unified around the common purpose of transforming healthcare to improve lives and we believe everyone has a role to play in that. When we work together across sites and specialties as an integrated healthcare team, we exceed the expectations of our patients and the hospitals and clinics we work in. If you are looking to make a difference, from clinical to corporate, Vituity is the place to do it. Come grow with us.

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands.   • Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.
  • Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.
  • Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.
  • Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.
  • Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.
  • Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.
  • Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.
  • Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

Preferred

  • Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).
  • Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).
  • Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

jobs.description:

Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis

  • Lead and document working sessions with clinical, finance, operations, product, and technical stakeholders to understand existing workflows, business rules, data requirements, and operational processes.
  • Translate manual and system-supported workflows into structured business and functional requirements.
  • Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities.
  • Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope.
  • Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable.

System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis

  • Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior.
  • Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development.
  • Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior.
  • Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic.
  • Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components.
  • Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations.

Requirements Authoring

  • Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds.
  • Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details.
  • Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality.
  • Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures.
  • Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation.

Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance

  • Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams.
  • Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions.
  • Identify ambiguity, conflicting requirements, downstream impacts, and cross-feature dependencies before development begins.
  • Prevent scope drift and ensure implementation-specific requirements do not unintentionally become platform-wide requirements.
  • Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk.

Ticket Creation & Scoping

  • Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to clarify technical scope and implementation approach.
  • Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities.
  • Identify common capabilities that can support multiple clients, workflows, or future implementations rather than creating one-off solutions.
  • 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, or equivalent role in a software-, data-, or technology-driven environment.
  • Experience working within healthcare technology, healthcare operations, payer/provider systems, pharmacy, claims, revenue cycle, eligibility, or related healthcare domains.
  • Ability to understand and reason about SQL, data structures, system logic, APIs, configuration, and technical workflows well enough to validate platform behavior and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets that engineering teams can implement with minimal rework.
  • Strong analytical rigor with the ability to distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, challenge unclear reasoning, and validate conclusions.
  • Experience facilitating requirements and solution-review sessions involving business, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt business and technical information for different audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with healthcare claims, eligibility, reimbursement, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, or healthcare financial processes.
  • Experience working with configurable or rules-driven healthcare platforms.
  • Experience supporting client, provider, health system, or partner implementations.
  • Understanding of data pipelines, ETL processes, APIs, healthcare integrations, and data exchange concepts.
  • Experience managing a shared product backlog across multiple customers, implementations, or business units.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards, regulatory requirements, or privacy considerations such as HIPAA.

Key Competencies

  • Requirements elicitation and translation
  • Healthcare workflow analysis
  • Technical and data analysis
  • System behavior reconciliation
  • Product and backlog management
  • Stakeholder facilitation and decision-driving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Analytical rigor and structured problem-solving
  • Dependency and impact analysis
  • Documentation discipline and traceability

jobs.description:
