jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Platform & Developer Experience)
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

Our Platform engineering team is growing up. Two engineering teams, Developer Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, build the foundations every 9fin engineer and product squad relies on. We now need a senior Product Manager to sit across both and bring product discipline to how the platform is shaped.

Today, Platform runs on speed and engineering instinct. You will help it work more like a product team. You will own the upfront work of problem definition, internal user research, prioritisation and success criteria, so engineers can focus on building the right things. Engineers are your customers: you will interview them, compare solutions, synthesise what you learn, and turn it into a clear roadmap. You will also own quarterly strategy and priorities planning across both teams, balancing operational and support demand against building the self-service platform of the future.

You will work closely with two engineering leads and their teams, and partner with product squads across the organisation who depend on the platform. Day-to-day triage will largely stay with platform engineers, so you can focus on the decisions that matter most. This is a high-autonomy role with direct access to engineering leadership and real scope to define what “platform as a product” means at 9fin. You will also make the value of platform work visible, using data to show where it makes teams more effective and celebrating the wins.

Key responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for the platform product squad.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from engineering surveys, interviews, and usage data to craft clear problem statements, articulating root causes in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Run structured discovery with internal engineering customers - interviews, usage analysis, survey synthesis - to understand developer workflows, identify friction, and build confidence before investing.

  • Impact driven: Define and align the team around key outcomes and effectively prioritise across Dev Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, distinguishing urgent requests from long-term investments that benefit multiple teams.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics that capture platform value and make the impact of platform work visible across the engineering org.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team Success: Create a collaborative environment across Dev Experience and Cloud Infrastructure, providing wider context and clear goals so engineers can do their best work. Celebrate platform wins and build a culture where engineers trust the roadmap.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complicated technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower your squads to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside your team - including product and feature teams who depend on you.

  • Stakeholder Management: Work with internal engineering stakeholders to gather the right input, ensuring they have the information to effectively represent the platform team within their own areas.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • You are an experienced platform product manager. You have solid experience in platform product management, preferably in the FinTech or B2B SaaS space, and you're eager to solve internal platform users' problems, drive adoption, and measure impact.

  • You have technical and analytical fluency. You understand developer workflows well enough to investigate problems independently, interrogate data, and challenge assumptions with evidence. You have an outstanding ability to think on your feet and tackle intellectually challenging problems. You are highly analytical and comfortable using data to make decisions.

  • You've got a keen interest in AI. You actively use AI in your day-to-day, attend courses, follow industry developments, and attend relevant talks about AI. You are ready to work closely with technical teams to understand different approaches and translate product goals into clear platform requirements.

  • You're a collaborative leader. You have an empathetic leadership style and build strong, effective relationships. You love working autonomously but are able to earn the trust of others with a collaborative style. You are a great prioritiser, not afraid to say no, and excel at managing stakeholders while also being confident in voicing your own opinions and challenging others.

  • A software engineering or platform engineering background is a significant plus.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Quarterly team socials

With your Senior engineering manager, you’ll lead your squad through discovery, shaping, development, and delivery. Balancing strategic thinking with execution to shape the future of our platform. You’ll work closely with our customer and operation teams to gather insights and requirements, validate solutions, and problem solve while using quantitative and qualitative data to make evidence-based decisions.

You’ll work at the heart of your squad, prioritising and maintaining a consistent view across your team of what you should be building and why. You’ll balance competing priorities and technical initiatives against your own strategic view, aligning the resultant roadmap with risk and compliance to ensure a balance of product improvement, innovation and regulatory integrity.

What you’ll own...

You’ll be responsible for building with your squad, developing a broader strategic direction and coordinating with Product leadership in a domain that’s centred around how Seccl’s customers set-up and operate. You’ll parse information in your domain and develop that into a roadmap with associated discovery and shaping.

These are some of the main problem spaces that you’ll be working on:

  • Firm onboarding, set-up and branding: Ensuring that firms can start making the most of Seccl’s products. That starts early in the launch process and carries through to how companies with billions of pounds under management can run their businesses on our platform effectively.

  • KYC, AML and sanction screening: Working closely with our Risk team and customers to deliver products and workflows that keep all parties compliant and assured. As a regulated entity and organisation that cares about the longevity of our business, this is foundational.

  • Operational Products: Solving problems for ops users as they manage how end investors interact with our processes. Ensuring that Seccl can continue to scale smoothly.

  • Technical touch points: Improving how Seccl’s webhooks communicate events and how our technical documentation facilitates integration and feature adoption.

  • Lead discovery, shaping and delivery with your squad engineering manager, aligning teams on what to build and why

This role’s for you if...

  • You’ve worked in a Product role and understand how to turn problems into useful products in a B2B2C space

  • You’re a builder who cares about what existing and future customers actually need

  • You’re curious and empathetic, and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand problems and test solutions

  • You can balance competing priorities, make pragmatic trade-offs and explain your reasoning clearly

  • You partner effectively with engineering, operations, customers and risk or compliance stakeholders

  • You’re comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of a scaling business

  • You have experience in fintech, particularly in an early-stage or scaling business, and with regulated products.

Who you are...

  • A builder: The thing that you want to do is build what our customers, both existing and future, want to use. All the things that you do and how you approach the day-to-day are orientated around this.

jobs.title: VP Sales
jobs.description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking a VP Sales to lead new business development with government and large space sector customers. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thrives on winning major contracts personally, not just directing a team from a distance.

You bring deep, current knowledge of the satellite sales landscape, a track record of closing significant contracts, and the seniority to represent NewOrbit at the highest level with strategic customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Win and close contracts: Lead high-value deals with governments and large space organisations, from first conversation through to signature.

  • Own the full sales cycle: Sourcing, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close - across every stage.

  • Build strategic relationships: Develop and maintain senior-level relationships across government agencies, primes, and major operators.

  • Set commercial strategy: Shape and execute NewOrbit's sales approach for government and enterprise customers.

  • Represent NewOrbit externally: Executive-level presence at customer meetings, government engagements, and industry events.

  • Partner internally: Work closely with engineering and delivery teams to scope deals that are commercially sound and deliverable.

  • Report to leadership: Own pipeline, forecasting, and deal status reporting to the board.

  • Grow the function: Build out a wider sales team as the business scales.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Satellite sales experience (required): Direct, hands-on experience selling satellites specifically, across the full sales process. Current, up-to-date knowledge of the satellite customer landscape.

  • Deal track record: Demonstrated history of winning significant (single-digit million £) contracts with large space organizations and/or governments.

  • Seniority: Minimum 10 years in space industry sales; realistically 15-20+ years. This is a senior hire.

  • Career focus: Majority, ideally the entirety, of your career spent in the space industry.

  • Relationship-led approach: A strong, established professional network across government, primes, and major operators, built through years of direct engagement in the sector.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

You’ll be responsible for maintaining the smooth day-to-day flow of the office while upholding our high standards of accuracy and security.     Accurately handle, inspect, and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments in accordance with company protocols and international shipping standards.

  • Operational Support:

    Work closely with your two team members to manage the daily operations of the office, ensuring all logistics processes run smoothly and efficiently

  • Precision & Security:

    Maintain the highest level of precision, confidentiality, and security when dealing with high-value goods—attention to detail is non-negotiable in this role.

  • Team Collaboration:

    Collaborate with senior team members to align on priorities, share insights, and uphold our collective standards of excellence.

  • Process Improvement:

    Contribute ideas to improve workflows and increase operational efficiency as the company continues to scale rapidly.

    Be proactive, reliable, and open to learning. This role offers strong internal growth potential for individuals who show initiative and dedication.

  • Team-Oriented Mindset

  • Basic Administrative Skills

  • Trustworthiness & Discretion

Highly desirable

  • Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures.

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

The Compliance & Recording team owns 1GLOBAL's products for regulated enterprises. We capture mobile voice, SMS and data at network level, with no app on the device, and deliver it to wherever our customers need it: their own on-site recorders and archives, or our Cloud Compliance service built on Verint Financial Compliance. On top of the recordings we offer Communications Analytics, which brings AI transcription, summaries and risk insights to compliance teams.

You will lead product strategy and delivery for Compliance & Recording, from the APIs and delivery channels that move recorded data into customer environments to the AI capabilities we build on top of it.

  • Define and evolve how recorded voice, SMS and data reach customers through APIs, SFTP, SMTP and S3 bucket pushes, choosing the right mechanism for each use case.
  • Write precise technical requirements: API contracts, payload and metadata schemas, delivery guarantees, retry and failure handling, security controls and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead large projects for our biggest compliance customers, onboarding their engineering and compliance teams with proper documentation, from scoping through rollout.
  • Define and track success metrics such as delivery success rate, latency, capture completeness and time to integrate, and keep the roadmap aligned with regulatory change and the competitive landscape.

  • Clear, precise writing: requirements, acceptance criteria and edge cases that engineering teams can build from without guesswork.

jobs.title: UX Research Intern
jobs.description:
About baesh

baesh is a social platform connecting people in real life through events, communities, and shared interests.

We’re a small team using AI to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. Research is central to how we decide what to build and whether it’s good enough to ship. Your work will help us stay close to people as the technology moves faster.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Product and UX, an experienced researcher with a PhD in emotional and behavioural research. You’ll get practical guidance across the research process—from deciding what to investigate to helping the team act on what we learn.

This is an unpaid mandatory internship for students whose university programme requires a placement.

  • Location: Mostly remote, with opportunities to join research and events in Berlin.

  • Start date: Flexible, depending on your university requirements.

  • Duration: As required by your university, usually 3–6 months.

What you’ll help with

Usability testing and idea validation

  • Help plan and run usability tests on our app and prototypes, including interfaces built with AI.

  • Explore how easily people can discover events, join communities, and create their profiles.

  • Test whether experiences make sense to real people, beyond looking polished or functioning technically.

  • Validate early ideas and assumptions before the team invests further.

  • Identify confusing moments and recommend improvements that make a meaningful difference.

Exploratory research and interviews

  • Help interview existing users and people who haven’t tried baesh yet.

  • Explore how people make friends, find things to do, and connect with communities.

  • Understand their needs, motivations, habits, and barriers.

  • Help write discussion guides and ask open questions that uncover useful insights.

  • Bring people’s experiences into product decisions, keeping the human connection at the heart of how we build.

AI-supported research

  • Use AI to help draft interview guides, usability-testing scripts, and survey questions.

  • Explore how AI can support research synthesis by organising notes, summarising sessions, and suggesting patterns.

  • Check AI-generated summaries and interpretations against what participants actually said and did.

  • Learn where AI saves time, where it misses nuance, and where your judgement matters most.

  • Help us develop practical ways to combine faster research workflows with thoughtful, reliable findings.

Recruitment and ongoing feedback

  • Help recruit participants and coordinate research sessions.

  • Support Friends of BAESH, our community of early adopters who contribute through interviews, user testing, feedback, and feature suggestions.

  • Help create short in-app surveys about specific parts of the experience.

Making sense of what we learn

  • Analyse feedback and identify patterns across sessions.

  • Turn findings into clear insights and practical recommendations.

  • Share research with the product and development team to shape what happens next.

  • Help organise our research so we can build on previous learning.

You won’t be expected to do all of this independently from day one. We’ll guide you, give you feedback, and gradually help you take ownership of research activities.

What you’ll bring

  • You’re enrolled in a degree programme that requires a mandatory internship.

  • An interest in UX research, psychology, human–computer interaction, design, sociology, or a related field.

  • Curiosity about people and a willingness to question assumptions.

  • Good listening skills and an empathetic, respectful approach.

  • Strong communication skills in English.

  • An organised approach and willingness to take initiative.

  • An interest in using AI thoughtfully, including questioning its output.

Preferred, but not required:

  • German-speaking, so you can support research with German-speaking participants.

  • Some familiarity with interviews, usability testing, surveys, or qualitative analysis—university projects count.

  • Experience experimenting with AI tools for research, writing, analysis, or prototyping.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.

In this role, you'll...

    • Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users.
    • Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.
    • Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.
    • Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all.
    • Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirement

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost.
  • AI-fluent: you've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you
    • Speak at least conversational French
    • Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear.
    • Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance)
    • Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.
  • Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here.

If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

 

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
jobs.description:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.

Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.

We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet.

What you'll do

  • Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.
  • Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.
  • Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.
  • Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.
  • Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.
  • Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.

What we need from you

  • You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling.
  • You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. You're strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language.
  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication.
  • You build with agents. Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You'd rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human.
  • You build things others succeed with. You've designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted.
  • You drive problems to resolution. You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result.

If you hit a few of those boxes, we'd like to speak to you.

We'd be thrilled if you had

  • Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming.
  • Experience with MLIR, other compiler frameworks, or kernel DSLs such as Triton, Pallas, NKI, or CuTe.
  • Contributions to LLM serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, or a track record of taking end-to-end inference workloads to competitive performance on a hardware target.

Why join us

Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. You'll own a layer of a new programming model, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon and carried into the next generation.

Tensordyne Values

  • Think big. Pursue ambitious technical and business goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality matters in everything we build and deliver.
  • Own it and get it done. Take responsibility and drive results.
  • Operate with integrity. Be direct, transparent, and respectful.
  • Win as a team. Make the people around you more effective.
  • Value different perspectives. The strongest teams challenge assumptions and bring diverse experience to difficult problems.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

  • Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation.

  • Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One: contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning.

In the code

  • Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

  • Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

  • Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python, the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities


Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken?

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

jobs.title: Data Officer
jobs.description:
Als Data Officer speel je een belangrijke rol in het ondersteunen van het productontwikkelingsproces door technische gegevens over grondstoffen en verpakkingscomponenten te verzamelen en in te voeren in het Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) en Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systeem van het bedrijf. De functie omvat regelmatige communicatie met leveranciers om informatie op te vragen, de volledigheid van gegevens te controleren en ervoor te zorgen dat alle artikelgegevens accuraat en up-to-date zijn.

Deze functie is ideaal voor iemand met veel oog voor detail en interesse in cosmetica, gegevensbeheer of productontwikkeling.

 

Ons Data team maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Regulatory Affairs. De afdeling bestaat uit twee Regulatory Affairs Specialisten, vier Regulatory Affairs Officers. en twee Data Officers. In deze functie rapporteer je aan de Manager Regulatory Affairs.

MISSION

  • Het bij leveranciers opvragen en verzamelen van technische gegevens, specificaties en documentatie voor grondstoffen en verpakkingen.

  • De door leveranciers ingediende documenten controleren op volledigheid en juistheid (bijv. INCI-lijsten, veiligheidsinformatiebladen, specificaties, certificaten, enz.

  • Nauwkeurig invoeren en bijwerken van materiaal- en verpakkingsgegevens in het PLM- en ERP-systeem.

  • Bijhouden van openstaande leveranciersinformatie en indien nodig opvolgen.

  • Ondersteunen van interne teams (Innovation & Research, Regulatory Affairs en Purchase) met nauwkeurige gegevensbeschikbaarheid.

  • Assisteren bij het handhaven van datakwaliteitsnormen en documentatietemplates.

  • Meewerken aan basis PLM-gegevensaudits en verbeteringsinitiatieven.

YOU

  • Een MBO-diploma scheikunde, farmakunde, verpakkingstechniek of een verwant vakgebied is een pré;

  • Enige ervaring met gegevensinvoer, productdocumentatie of leverancierscoördinatie heeft de voorkeur;

  • Sterk oog voor detail en nauwkeurigheid van gegevens;

  • Goede organisatorische- en tijdmanagementvaardigheden;

  • Duidelijke en professionele communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk in het Nederlands en Engels;

  • Vermogen om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken in een multifunctioneel team;


OUR OFFER

  • Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie;

  • Een duurzaamheidsbewuste werkgever;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding;

  • 27 vrije dagen per jaar (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband);

  • Een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Salarisschaal: € 2.700 - € 3.200;

  • Aandacht voor jouw mentale welzijn door onbeperkt toegang tot OpenUp;

  • Deelname aan groepslessen bij Personel Fitness Soest;

  • En nooit meer een ‘bad hair day’ dankzij de personeelskortingen op de gehele Keune collectie!

KEUNE

Wij zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap het hart van alles is wat we doen. Ons verhaal begon in 1922 in Amsterdam. Keune is een van de snelstgroeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden Keune-producten wereldwijd ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en gedistribueerd naar meer dan 90 landen. Met een sterke focus op duurzaamheid en diervriendelijke praktijken, zijn we B-Corp-gecertificeerd en blijven we uitbreiden door jaarlijks een nieuwe locatie te openen.

Onder leiding van Philip Berlijn richten wij ons op het bouwen van een sterk merk, het bevorderen van samenwerking, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter in alles wat we doen.


KEUNE
PREMIUM HAIR CARE SINCE 1922


ONZE INZET VOOR DIVERSITEIT, GELIJKHEID EN INCLUSIE

Wij zetten ons in voor een diverse, rechtvaardige en inclusieve werkomgeving. Wij staan open voor kandidaten van alle achtergronden, identiteiten en ervaringen, en wij discrimineren niet op basis van genderidentiteit of -expressie, seksuele geaardheid, etniciteit, nationaliteit, religie, leeftijd, handicap, neurodiversiteit of enig ander beschermd kenmerk. jobs.title: Teamleider Behandel- en Expertisecentrum Zodiak | 32-36 uur | Purmerend
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan de toekomst van de specialistische behandelzorg

Binnen het Behandel- en Expertisecentrum Zodiak van Prinsenstichting zetten we de volgende stap in de ontwikkeling van onze behandeldienst. De basis staat stevig en daardoor ontstaat ruimte voor verdere innovatie en ontwikkeling. Daarom breiden we ons leiderschapsteam uit met een derde Teamleider.

Voor deze nieuwe positie zoeken wij een verbindende en ondernemende leidinggevende die richting geeft aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze individuele en ambulante behandeling. Een professional die kansen ziet, mensen in beweging krijgt en samen met behandelaren bouwt aan toekomstbestendige zorg.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Teamleider van het Behandel- en Expertisecentrum Zodiak geef je leiding aan een aantal behandeldisciplines en professionals binnen onze behandeldienst. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van medewerkers en draagt tegelijkertijd actief bij aan de doorontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening.

De focus van deze functie ligt op het verder vormgeven van onze ambulante en individuele behandelzorg. Je onderzoekt samen met behandelaren hoe we onze expertise nog beter toegankelijk kunnen maken voor cliënten, verwanten en verwijzers. Daarbij werk je aan kwaliteit, samenwerking, doelmatigheid en innovatie.

Je beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen operationele vraagstukken en strategische ontwikkelingen en weet professionals mee te nemen in verandering.

Als Teamleider:

  • Geef je leiding aan een team van gespecialiseerde behandelprofessionals;

  • Coach en ondersteun je medewerkers in hun professionele ontwikkeling;

  • Ben je verantwoordelijk voor een efficiënte organisatie van de werkzaamheden, bezetting en productie;

  • Draag je zorg voor het realiseren van afgesproken resultaten en financiële doelstellingen;

  • Geef je uitvoering aan de ontwikkelopgave rondom individuele en ambulante behandeling;

  • Stimuleer je samenwerking tussen disciplines, locaties en externe partners;

  • Vertaal je maatschappelijke en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen binnen de behandeldienst;

  • Lever je een actieve bijdrage aan beleidsontwikkeling, jaarplannen en innovatieprojecten;

  • Ben je een sparringpartner voor de manager van het Behandel- en Expertisecentrum.

Over Zodiak

Zodiak is het Behandel- en Expertisecentrum van Prinsenstichting. Binnen Zodiak werken verschillende disciplines samen aan diagnostiek, behandeling van mensen met een verstandelijke beperking en hun naasten. Onze professionals bieden zowel intra- als extramurale ondersteuning en beschikken over specialistische kennis op uiteenlopende vakgebieden.

De komende jaren richten we ons op drie belangrijke ontwikkellijnen:

  • Regie op behandeling;

  • Individuele behandeling;

  • Disciplineontwikkeling en expertise.

Voor de ontwikkellijn Individuele Behandeling zoeken wij een teamleider die deze opdracht verder vorm en inhoud geeft.


Dit ben jij

Je bent een verbindende leider die mensen weet te inspireren en tegelijkertijd koers houdt. Je vindt het leuk om organisaties en teams verder te ontwikkelen en krijgt energie van vernieuwing. Je kunt verschillende belangen overzien en weet deze samen te brengen in een gezamenlijke ambitie.

Daarnaast:

  • Beschik je over een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van bedrijfskunde, gezondheidszorgmanagement of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • Heb je ervaring met leidinggeven aan professionals;

  • Heb je affiniteit met zorg, behandeling of dienstverlening binnen een complexe organisatie;

  • Ben je analytisch sterk en resultaatgericht;

  • Heb je ervaring met verandertrajecten of organisatieontwikkeling;

  • Weet je samenwerking te stimuleren binnen multidisciplinaire teams;

  • Heb je oog voor zowel de inhoud als de mens.

Dit bieden wij

Een unieke kans om mede vorm te geven aan de toekomst van een specialistische behandeldienst binnen de gehandicaptenzorg.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een contract voor één jaar met uitzicht op verlenging;

  • Een salaris conform FWG 60 van de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg (€ 4.077,- tot € 5.926,- bruto per maand bij 36 uur);

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;

  • Laptop en telefoon;

  • Ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 uur balansverlof bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Een uitdagende functie met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en impact.

jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
jobs.description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

jobs.title: Data Scientist H/F - Paris
jobs.description:
AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ?

Vous souhaitez donner du sens aux données et développer des modèles prédictifs qui répondent à des enjeux métiers concrets ? Rejoignez AVISIA et participez à des projets Data Science à forte valeur ajoutée !

Créée en 2007, AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital. Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production.

Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering et Intelligence Artificielle. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets stimulants pour faire de la donnée un véritable levier de transformation.

Nous accompagnons des clients issus de secteurs variés, notamment le Luxe, le Retail, les Télécoms, la Banque, l’Assurance et l’Industrie. Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques allant de l’analyse exploratoire des données à la conception, l’évaluation et l’industrialisation de modèles de Machine Learning.

Nos missions en Data Science

Chez AVISIA, nous vous proposons des missions qui allient expertise technique, Data Science et compréhension des enjeux business. Selon votre profil, vos compétences et vos affinités, vous pourrez intervenir sur des projets variés, de la conception de modèles prédictifs à leur déploiement en production, en passant par l’analyse des données et l’optimisation des performances.

L’objectif : concevoir des solutions concrètes, exploiter pleinement le potentiel des données et contribuer directement à la prise de décision de nos clients.

Quelques exemples de sujets de Data Scientist du moment :

  • Conception de modèles de prévision du chiffre d'affaires généré sur le site e-commerce d’un retailer. #Prévision

  • Création et industrialisation d’un moteur de recommandation destiné à optimiser la conversion des visiteurs du site web. #Recommandation

  • Création d’un score d’attrition afin d’identifier les clients d’un acteur de la grande distribution en perte de vitesse lente, #Churn

  • Mise en œuvre d’une segmentation client permettant d'optimiser les actions marketing & commerciales d'une enseigne (ciblage, rétention, en fonction des appétences de canaux de contact). #SegmentationClient


Les qualités humaines

Chez AVISIA, nous recherchons avant tout des talents curieux, impliqués et désireux de progresser. Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes ?

  • Vous avez un excellent relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe comme les échanges avec les clients.

  • Vous aimez vous impliquer dans les projets et contribuer concrètement à la réussite des missions.

  • Vous disposez d’un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, avec la capacité de prendre du recul sur les résultats obtenus.

  • Vous êtes attentif(ve) à la qualité de vos livrables et savez présenter et vulgariser des résultats complexes auprès d’interlocuteurs non techniques.

  • Vous êtes curieux(se), vous vous intéressez aux évolutions de la Data Science et du Machine Learning et aimez explorer de nouvelles approches.

jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant

Over Ockto

Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Met ons platform kunnen consumenten veilig en eenvoudig hun persoonlijke en financiële gegevens delen, rechtstreeks vanuit betrouwbare bronnen.

Maar Ockto gaat verder dan alleen het verzamelen en delen van gegevens. We combineren, structureren, valideren en verrijken data tot complete, betrouwbare en direct bruikbare datasets. Hiermee helpen we organisaties om processen verder te automatiseren, betere beslissingen te nemen en aanvragen zoveel mogelijk volledig automatisch af te handelen (Straight Through Processing).

Onze technologie wordt ingezet door een groot aantal gerenommeerde partijen binnen Nederland, waaronder banken, leasemaatschappijen, hypotheekverstrekkers, online webshops, en overheidsinstellingen. Zo verminderen we handmatige werkzaamheden, versnellen we doorlooptijden en verbeteren we de klantbeleving, met privacy, veiligheid en compliance als belangrijke uitgangspunten.

Met meer dan 100 aangesloten organisaties bouwen we dagelijks verder aan een toekomst waarin betrouwbare data de basis vormt voor slimme, efficiënte en volledig digitale dienstverlening.

De rol

We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Business Consultant die organisaties helpt complexe business vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en nieuwe zakelijke kansen.

In deze rol combineer je strategisch inzicht met een commerciële blik. Je verdiept je in de behoeften, processen en uitdagingen van klanten en onderzoekt hoe Ockto's technologie hierop kan aansluiten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de directe vraag van een klant: je begrijpt de achterliggende behoeften en weet deze te vertalen naar mogelijkheden die zowel voor de klant als voor Ockto waarde toevoegen.

Je bent een volwaardige gesprekspartner voor verschillende stakeholders en weet complexe onderwerpen helder te maken. Je bouwt relaties op, signaleert kansen en draagt bij aan de verdere groei van Ockto. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's uit onder andere sales, marketing, account management en consulting. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen om Ockto’s positie in de markt verder te versterken, waarbij je actief bijdraagt aan het benutten van sales mogelijkheden en het uitbouwen van klantrelaties.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren professional die analytisch en strategisch kan denken, maar ook begrijpt hoe je zakelijke kansen realiseert. Je weet de juiste vragen te stellen, kunt snel tot de kern van een vraagstuk komen en voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met uiteenlopende stakeholders.

Je combineert sterke consultancy vaardigheden met commercieel inzicht. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe organisaties werken, begrijpt complexe processen en weet deze te vertalen naar concrete mogelijkheden. Daarbij neem je initiatief, bouw je gemakkelijk relaties op en verlies je de praktische en commerciële doelstellingen niet uit het oog.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring in business consulting, consultative sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Ervaring met het adviseren van zakelijke klanten en het analyseren van complexe business vraagstukken.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op verschillende niveaus.

  • Het vermogen om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en zakelijke kansen.

  • Een combinatie van analytisch vermogen, strategisch inzicht en commerciële slagkracht.

  • Affiniteit met SaaS, fintech, data oplossingen of digitale dienstverlening is een pré.

Wat biedt Ockto?

  • De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van een Nederlandse SaaS scaleup met een bewezen platform en een groeiend klantenbestand.

Founders’ Associate (m/w/d) – Management Track | PraxisEins, Düsseldorf

In vielen Regionen Deutschlands finden Hausärztinnen und Hausärzte keine Nachfolge mehr. Patientinnen und Patienten stehen dann ohne Versorgung da. Wir ändern das, und suchen jemanden, der dabei vom ersten Tag an echte unternehmerische Verantwortung übernimmt.

Über PraxisEins
PraxisEins baut Deutschlands führenden Primärversorger auf. Wir übernehmen Hausarztpraxen, digitalisieren sie mit eigener Software und verbessern kontinuierlich die Patientenversorgung, gerade dort, wo sie am dringendsten gebraucht wird. Seit unserer Gründung 2022 sind wir auf über 400 Mitarbeitende gewachsen. jobs.title: Director of Procurement & Trading
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Role

This is not a traditional procurement role. At Andercore, procurement is trading: fast-paced, market-driven, and executed daily — not on quarterly or annual cycles. You will lead a team of young and hungry category managers, through high-volume purchasing decisions in a dynamic environment where prices, availability, and supplier landscapes shift constantly.

You will own end-to-end procurement strategy and execution: sourcing, onboarding to the system, supplier negotiations and disputes, pricing, team leadership, and process design. We need someone who can think strategically and execute operationally every single day — from setting category strategy to approving individual purchase orders. You will be in the driver seat to build the first AI automated trading engine - a unique opportunity in the industrial supply space.

You report directly to the C level and sit on the commercial and operations leadership team. Andercore uses AI extensively across the business; you will be expected to leverage it to drive efficiency, margins, and scalability in procurement.

The core purpose of this role is to build one buying strategy that combines three things:

  • Spot trading, run as a repeatable system with a regular market-coverage schedule and clear KPIs;

  • Strategic buying, where you negotiate allocations, framework agreements and terms with Tier-1 manufacturers and develop private-label and direct-from-factory categories;

  • Supply planning, where you set the mix of spot, contract and stock and keep price and inventory risk under control.

Each part on its own is not enough. The job is to make them work together so that Andercore buys at the right price, secures supply when the market tightens, and never holds stock it cannot sell.

What You Will Do

  • Build and run the procurement machine: Develop and execute procurement strategies that support an 8-digit monthly procurement spend with exponential growth. Negotiate favourable terms, pricing, and contracts with suppliers on a daily basis.

  • Lead and develop the team: Manage 10+ team members, set clear priorities daily, coach emerging team leads, and create a culture of accountability and speed. You will need to be assertive and hands-on. Be the player-coach. Close deals yourself and hire the people you need to scale

  • Create scalable processes: Design, implement, and continuously improve procurement workflows, playbooks, and controls. Processes are implemented in days and weeks at Andercore — not quarters and years.

  • Own supplier relationships: Source, evaluate, and onboard suppliers. Maintain and expand a high-quality supplier network with strong retention across existing and emerging markets.

  • Drive margin improvement: Identify cost-saving opportunities, optimise purchasing decisions, and improve payment terms to boost net revenue margin and cash cycle.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Logistics, Accounting, and Product & Engineering to align supply with demand and ensure operational excellence.

  • Full P&L responsibility: for the supply side.

  • Leverage data and AI: Use data to inform purchasing decisions, monitor supplier performance, and identify market trends. Embrace AI tools to automate and scale procurement operations.

  • AI-native procurement: automate processes from RFQs through to order confirmations, with sellers as co-designers of the agents.

What Success Looks Like

  • Revenue and margin targets consistently met or exceeded through high availability and competitive pricing.

  • A robust, high-quality supplier network with strong retention and engagement across existing and emerging markets.

  • Streamlined, repeatable processes that reduce time-to-onboard, minimise errors, and allow the team to scale without linear headcount growth.

  • A high-performing, motivated team with emerging team leads and strong cross-functional collaboration.

  • Accurate, data-driven reporting that drives continuous improvement and informs executive strategy.

  • Run a category management that unlocks and owns new product lines

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a top university or business school.

  • 4+ years in a high-performance environment: for example commodity trading / high-velocity B2B procurement.

  • Proven ability to build processes and delegate effectively. You must be able to create systems that outlast your personal involvement — not do everything yourself.

  • Strong assertiveness and people leadership. You will manage a young team that needs clear direction, daily prioritisation, and coaching.

  • Ability to operate at both strategic and granular levels: setting category strategy in the morning and reviewing individual POs in the afternoon.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills.

  • Fluent English is required; German is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable with a high-intensity, fast-paced startup environment where priorities can shift daily.

  • Proven results negotiating from the smaller side of the table, i.e. securing allocation, pricing and terms when you are not the biggest customer.

  • Hard-working, proactive, and independent. Willing to go the extra mile to get the job done.

  • A personal track record in spot or commodity trading with margin ownership.

  • Experience scaling a team, plus forecasting and inventory risk management.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, SaaS, or construction / infrastructure / energy materials.

  • Exposure to AI-driven operations or automation of procurement workflows.

  • Familiarity with cross-border trade and international supplier management.

  • Tier-1 strategy consulting background (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain).

This Role Is Not For You If…

  • Your procurement experience is in slow-cycle, enterprise purchasing (annual contracts, quarterly reviews). Our cadence is daily.

  • You are strong on analysis but weak on implementation. We need someone who executes, not just diagnoses.

  • You prefer to do things yourself rather than build teams and processes. Delegation and system-building are non-negotiable.

  • You need a fully structured environment to be effective. Here, you will create the structure.

What We Offer

  • A critical leadership role with direct impact on company growth and P&L.

  • Highly competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

  • A smart, ambitious team backed by top-tier investors — building something that doesn’t exist yet.

  • Berlin headquarters with a global, multicultural operating environment.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.
